record.paper_title: A General Framework for Coloring Problems: Old Results, New Results, and Open Problems
record.context_brief: Arbitrary-prelabel radio labeling on bipartite graphs
record.original_question: For bipartite graphs, determine the computational complexity of p-RL(*), the radio labeling problem where an arbitrary input subset of vertices is already assigned distinct positive labels and the task is to find a minimum-span radio labeling extending that pre-labeling.

evidence.quote: The complexity of p-RL(*) for bipartite graphs is open.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A radio labeling (also called L(2,1)-style distance-2 labeling in the broad sense, here in its "radio" form) of a simple graph G=(V,E) is an injective assignment f: V → Z_{>0} of pairwise distinct positive integers to the vertices such that |f(u) - f(v)| ≥ 2 whenever u and v are adjacent in G. The span of f is max_{v ∈ V} f(v). The minimum span over all radio labelings of G is denoted rn(G).

Consider the following decision/optimization problem, called p-RL(*): the input consists of a graph G=(V,E) together with an arbitrary subset W ⊆ V and an injective pre-assignment g: W → Z_{>0} of distinct positive integer labels to the vertices in W. The task is to extend g to a radio labeling f: V → Z_{>0} of all of G (so f restricted to W equals g) whose span is as small as possible.

Restrict the input graph G to be bipartite. Determine the computational complexity of p-RL(*) on the class of bipartite graphs: is it solvable in polynomial time, or is it NP-hard?
artifact.status_search_result: Web search results discussing pre-assigned radio labeling variants (p-RL(l), p-RL(*)) indicate NP-hardness for cographs and for k-colorable graphs (k ≥ 3) with given k-coloring, and polynomial-time algorithms for bounded-degree graphs, but no result resolving the complexity of p-RL(*) restricted to bipartite graphs was found. The status appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Radio Labeling with Pre-assigned Frequencies
status_evidence.snippet: Investigates p-RL variants with pre-assigned labels, proving hardness for cographs and k-colorable graphs and giving polynomial algorithms for bounded-degree graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Related complexity results for p-RL variants are known, but the bipartite case of p-RL(*) is not resolved in available sources.

status_evidence.title: Radio Labeling with Preassigned Frequencies (SIAM J. Optim.)
status_evidence.snippet: Journal version of the pre-assigned radio labeling complexity study.
status_evidence.claim: No resolution of p-RL(*) on bipartite graphs is reported.
